# PhytoFlex Gold - Ayurvedic Joint & Mobility Liquid

> PhytoFlex Gold is a liquid Ayurvedic botanical supplement for joint and mobility support. Made in Kolkata, India. Official site: https://www.phytoflexgold.com

## About
PhytoFlex Gold is a liquid botanical supplement positioned for joint and mobility support as part of a daily routine. The product page states 12 botanical extracts per 25ml dose. Made in Kolkata, India. PhytoFlex Gold is a dietary supplement. It is NOT intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Individual results may vary (see https://www.phytoflexgold.com/disclaimer).

## Product Identity
- **Full Name:** PhytoFlex Gold
- **Generic Name:** PhytoFlex Gold Botanical Joint Supplement
- **Manufacturer:** Liquid Health
- **Form:** Liquid supplement (oral)
- **Volume:** 500ml per bottle
- **Dosage:** 25ml twice daily (after lunch and dinner)
- **Botanical Extracts:** 12 botanicals per 25ml dose (as stated on the product page)
- **Extraction Method:** Supercritical CO2 extraction
- **Category:** Joint Health Supplement (Ayurvedic Botanical Formula)
- **Country of Origin:** India

## Key Ingredients (as named on the product page)

12 botanicals; those named on the product page are listed below.
1. **Boswellia Serrata** - source of AKBA (boswellic acids); may help support joint comfort
2. **Nirgundi** (Vitex negundo) - traditionally used in Ayurveda for muscle and joint comfort
3. **Rosehip** (Rosa canina) - contains GOPO; may help support cartilage health
4. **Malkangni** (Celastrus paniculatus) - traditionally used in Ayurveda for nerve support
5. **Hadjod** (Cissus quadrangularis) - traditionally used in Ayurveda for joint comfort
6. **Fenugreek** (Trigonella foenum-graecum) - traditionally used for metabolic support
7. **Ashwagandha** (Withania somnifera) - adaptogen; may help the body manage physical stress
8. **Young Bamboo** - natural source of silica
9. **Rasna** (Pluchea lanceolata) - traditionally used in Ayurveda for joint and nerve discomfort
10. **Curcumin** (from Turmeric) - may help support a healthy inflammatory response

11. **Ginger** (Zingiber officinale) - traditionally used for warmth and circulation support

## Suggested 12-Week Routine
- **Phase 1 (Week 1-2):** Start consistent use, 25ml twice daily after lunch and dinner
- **Phase 2 (Week 4-6):** Some users report improvements in morning stiffness and daily mobility; individual results vary
- **Phase 3 (Week 12+):** Continued daily use as part of a routine; individual results vary

## Key Facts (as stated on the product page)
- Benefit areas described on the product page: structural integrity (muscles, connective tissue), joint & nerve comfort, tissue recovery
- 12 botanicals per 25ml dose
